_note: Two Baidu interiors — a departures hall with a Korean Air sign and a bright check-in hall — now accompany the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

gmp-baidu-1.webp.zh: 金浦机场的出发大厅：方格吊顶下横挂着「KOREAN AIR」标识牌，两侧是广告屏与值机区。
gmp-baidu-1.webp.en: Gimpo's departures hall — a coffered ceiling with a hanging Korean Air sign, ad screens and check-in areas on either side.

gmp-baidu-2.webp.zh: 宽敞明亮的航站楼大厅：木质格栅吊顶下是一整面玻璃窗，旅客拉着行李箱从值机柜台前经过。
gmp-baidu-2.webp.en: A wide, bright terminal hall — a wooden slat ceiling above full-height windows, travellers with bags passing the check-in counters.

gmp-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，首尔金浦国际机场（GMP）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
gmp-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Seoul Gimpo International Airport (GMP) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
